title: Manual results ingestion input -- one file, a list of independently corroborated final scores
description: Consumed only by pcbf_calculator.orchestration.manual_results_settlement (ingest-manual-results). Every result must carry one or more independent sources; see that module's own docstring 'The corroboration gate' for the acceptance rule (one authoritative source, or two agreeing sources with distinct source_name) -- this schema only enforces SHAPE, never corroboration/business rules, which are checked in code against the parsed structure. competition_raw/home_team_raw/away_team_raw are the bare display names this codebase's own identity resolution already expects (e.g. 'Serie A', 'Bayern Munich') -- never a bookmaker- or results-page-specific format.

scheduled_date.description: UTC calendar date, matching this codebase's own scheduled_date convention everywhere else -- never a bookmaker-local date.

completion_status.description: Only COMPLETED is ever scored -- see REASON_NOT_COMPLETED. The other three values exist so a caller can positively record why a fixture was NOT scored, rather than omitting it silently.

source_name.description: A human-readable identifier for this source (e.g. the site or feed name) -- two sources with the SAME source_name never count as independent corroboration.

evidence_hash.description: SHA-256 of whatever was actually retrieved (a saved page snapshot, a screenshot, an API response body) -- so the evidence is in principle re-checkable later, never just an unverifiable assertion.

authoritative.description: A human judgment call: is this ONE source alone trustworthy enough to accept without a second corroborating source (e.g. the competition's own official site)? See the module docstring's corroboration rule.
